verdict.rationale: Productboard documents a catalog of native integrations with common tools: Jira, Azure DevOps, Zendesk, Microsoft Teams, GitHub, Figma, and Slack, Linear, Notion and Amplitude via Spark. Some of these import sales/support conversations and feedback messages into the workspace. However, nothing in the pack shows that connecting these tools takes only a few clicks; the quick-setup evidence covers only the MCP agent connection, not the third-party tool integrations. Missing for 10: documented few-click setup flow for native integrations, per-integration setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of ease of connection.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect common third-party tools to my feedback workspace in just a few clicks
